questions.question:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in blank no. (1) in the given passage. 
In the given passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage intently and choose the most appropriate 
option to fill in each blank: 
I was wandering through the park one evening when I noticed a man sitting alone on a bench. He wore frayed clothes, 
and his face was lined with (1) _______. He seemed deep in thought, staring at the ground as though searching for 
answers. I hesitated briefly before walking up to him. When I greeted him, he looked up and gave a faint smile. He 
started sharing his life with me—his victories and failures, love and loss. His stories were deeply moving, and his 
viewpoint felt truly (2) _____________. 
As the sun began to set, he stood up and thanked me for listening to his experiences. “Sometimes, all we need is 
someone to hear us,” he said. His words stayed with me, reminding me of the transformative (3) ___________ of human 
connection. That night, I felt humbled and (4) _________. Life is filled with unexpected encounters, and each one has 
the ability to (5) _______ us to see life differently.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct voice. 
She asked him if he had been to the new cafe that had opened the previous week, and whether he had tried their 
signature dessert or still preferred the old place they used to visit on weekends.
options:
(a) “Had you been to the new cafe that opened last week, and had you tried their signature dessert or did you still 
prefer the old place we used to visit on weekends?” she asked him.

(b) “Have you been to the new cafe that opened last week, and have you tried their signature dessert or do you still 
prefer the old place we used to visit on weekends?” she asked him.

(c) “Did you go to the new cafe that had opened the previous week, and did you try their signature dessert or do you 
still prefer the old place we had been visiting on weekends?” she asked him.

(d) “Have you gone to the new cafe that had opened the previous week, and did you try their signature dessert or still 
you prefer the old place used to visit on weekends?” she asked him.
questions.correct_answer:
(b) “Have you been to the new cafe that opened last week, and have you tried their signature dessert or do you still 
prefer the old place we used to visit on weekends?” she asked him.
